notes.title: Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44056675/b8fd2511fb6d67b1baf32fe4d66acefc962884da.jpg[/img]

🚨 Grab a controller because It's time for the [b]Steam Couch Co-Op Fest[/b]! 🚨

This season, [i][b]Crush Zone: Demolition Derby[/b][/i] is celebrating the thrill of couch co-op as part of the festival! To mark the occasion, we at Desert Beagle have added some fresh quality-of-life improvements to our demo.

Whether you're side by side on the couch or tearing it up online via Steam Remote Play, Crush Zone is built for pure multiplayer mayhem!

🔥 Split-screen battles? Check.
⚡ Online carnage? Absolutely. [i](Thanks, Steam Remote Play!)[/i]
💥 High-speed vehicular destruction? Always.

So, grab a friend (or a rival), jump in your ride, and wreak some havoc! And if you haven’t already, wishlist Crush Zone: Demolition Derby to stay in the loop! 🚗💨💥

[i]- The Desert Beagle Team.[/i]

notes.title: Coming to an OS Near You
notes.notes:
🚨 Exciting News! 🚨
As part of Desert Beagle’s ongoing effort to support platforms beyond just Windows.
[b]Crush Zone: Demolition Derby's demo[/b] is now available on both [b]macOS[/b]🍏 and [b]Linux / SteamOS [/b]🐧 systems too!

While macOS makes up approximately 1.3% of the Steam player base and Linux (including SteamOS) stands at around 1.92%, this still translates to a combined audience of about [b]1.23 million players[/b] out of Steam’s estimated 33.8 million users.

We recognize the growing importance of these platforms and are thrilled to cater to this emerging and niche community of passionate gamers. Whether you're revving your engines on [b]macOS[/b] 🏎️ or tearing up the derby on [b]Linux[/b] 🚗💨, we want to ensure that Crush Zone delivers the same exhilarating experience across all systems!

Plans are already in motion to expand Crush Zone beyond PC, so stay tuned for even more exciting news on the horizon. 🎮🚀 In the meantime, get behind the wheel and make sure to wishlist and follow for all the latest updates!

[i]- The Desert Beagle Team.[/i]

notes.title: Quick Fix Update 🚨
notes.notes:
In our latest demo for the Steam Planes, Trains, and Automobiles Fest, which includes some exciting new content, we’ve already spotted and patched a few bugs within the first day. Here’s what we fixed!

🔧 Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions on back weapons for:
- Stinger
- Spike Strips
- Oil Slick 
[*] Fixed an issue where the slip effect wasn’t being applied. Drive carefully! 🚗💨
[*] Fixed a bug where players continued to be attacked by the Power Saw even after it should have stopped.
[/list]
With that said, be sure to update, thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming! We're here to provide constant support and updates.

notes.title: Presenting in. . .
notes.notes:
The Desert Beagle team is excited to announce that Crush Zone: Demolition Derby will be part of. . .
Steam's Planes, Trains, and Automobiles Fest 2024! This festival celebrates all things vehicles—whether they have wheels, wings, or anything in between. Running from September 16 at 10:00 AM PDT to September 23 at 10:00 AM PDT, the event highlights a variety of vehicle-based games, including Crush Zone: Demolition Derby.

Even better, Crush Zone will release an updated demo for the event. Which includes some exciting new in-game features! Now’s your chance to dive into the chaos with fresh content and experience their signature high-octane, arcade-style vehicular combat at its finest.

And finally, Desert Beagle has released a short teaser trailer for this special moment!
So be sure to check out the new demo, new teaser and have fun causing chaos in the arenas!

notes.title: Presenting in. . .
notes.notes:
The Desert Beagle team are proud to present the most heart pounding, chest thumping, stomach dropping demolition derby game for Steam Next Fest 2024! Crush Zone: Demolition Derby is our first ever live demo on Steam, offering a taste of all the vehicular mayhem and madness that is still to come. Right here, next on Steam!

Welcome, fearless drivers, one and all, to the high stakes, high octane, and high flying adrenaline carnage that is Crush Zone: Demolition Derby. Here, you will compete in gladiatorial arenas of ice, fire, smoke, metal, wheels, and the thunderous roar of thousands. All cheering for you. With weapons and vehicles galore from which to choose, your goal is to ram, slam, and wham your opposition with everything you have. Send other drivers careering into deadly hazards or each other, drop traps behind you and launch death in front, and rack up points before they do the same to you.

So gear up. Strap in. And start. Your. Engines.
